reaction_network.interpretation: A, W and D are chemostatted reservoirs; X is the dynamic autocatalyst.

accounting.entropy_production_definition: sum_r v_r * (-DeltaG_r) / T, with activities relative to the 1 mol/L standard state
accounting.warning: Ideal-solution chemostatted reaction-network estimate, not a complete planetary entropy budget.

limitations: A, W and D are abstract species; no specific prebiotic chemistry is represented.
The model is well-mixed and has no spatial gradients, diffusion, compartments or mineral surfaces.
Chemostats hold reservoir activities fixed; their pumps and external apparatus are outside the model boundary.
The model has autocatalysis but no heredity, mutation, lineage or Darwinian evolution.
Reaction standard free energies are implied by illustrative equilibrium constants, not measured chemical data.
Entropy production is for the specified idealized reaction network and boundary, not total entropy production of the environment.
